mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_reports (id, reporter_id, reported_user_id, encrypted_content, iv) VALUES (#{id}, #{reporterId}, #{reportedUserId}, #{encryptedContent}, #{iv})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.reported_user_id, u.username AS reported_username, r.encrypted_content, r.iv, r.status, r.created_at FROM user_reports r JOIN users u ON r.reported_user_id = u.id WHERE r.reporter_id = #{reporterId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
